entries.template: Each of {objectCount} distinct files must be placed in exactly one of {boxCount} labelled folders. A folder may remain empty. How many assignments are possible?
In how many ways can {objectCount} distinct parcels be placed in {boxCount} numbered lockers so that every locker receives at least one parcel?
Each of {objectCount} distinct documents is filed in one of {boxCount} labelled cabinets. In how many assignments are exactly {nonEmptyBoxCount} cabinets used?
Each of {objectCount} distinct samples is sent to exactly one of {boxCount} labelled laboratories. How many assignments leave at least one laboratory unused?
In how many ways can {objectCount} distinct trainees be assigned to three named rooms if the rooms must receive exactly {firstOccupancy}, {secondOccupancy} and {thirdOccupancy} trainees respectively?
Each of {objectCount} distinct books is placed on one of {boxCount} numbered shelves. How many assignments put exactly {specifiedOccupancy} books on shelf 1, with no restriction on the other shelves?

Each of {objectCount} distinct applications is assigned to one of {boxCount} named desks. In how many assignments does desk 1 receive exactly {specifiedOccupancy} applications and every other desk receive at least one?
In how many ways can {objectCount} distinct tokens be divided among exactly {nonEmptyBoxCount} non-empty identical boxes, where swapping complete boxes does not create a new distribution?
In how many ways can {objectCount} distinct records be divided among at most {maximumNonEmptyBoxes} non-empty identical boxes, where the boxes have no labels?
In how many ways can {objectCount} distinct volunteers be divided into any number of non-empty unnamed groups?
